problem.title: Minimum Cost of Buying Candies With Discount

approaches.title: Greedy sorting with every third candy free
approaches.summary: Sort candy costs in descending order, then pay for the two most expensive candies in each group of three while receiving the third for free. This greedy strategy minimizes the total cost.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implemented the greedy solution with descending sort and a state counter that skips every third candy.
Refactored the same greedy strategy into a functional chunks-based implementation, summing the first two candies from each group of three.
